pre_freeze_corrections.finding: An unaligned native chunk end1001 was rounded down to992, incorrectly suppressing replay of structural target1000.
pre_freeze_corrections.resolution: Native chunk ends must already be16-aligned. Unaligned1001 raises; structural1000 still plans replay992; actual native992 may skip replay. Finished-turn flooring remains separately justified by decode page progression.

pre_freeze_corrections.finding: The equal-score zero-variance convention was described as continuous, but standardized rewards have no unique continuous extension at a constant vector.
pre_freeze_corrections.resolution: Documented as an explicit uniform tie convention, not a continuity theorem. No estimator math was changed.

pre_freeze_corrections.finding: The standalone source modules initially omitted the runner's explicit GPU-validation contract constant.
pre_freeze_corrections.resolution: Added False for CPU-only FrontierReplay and True for MV-JEPA, with contract assertions. No broader package initializer is loaded by the frozen runner.

pre_freeze_corrections.finding: Transport-gzip responses were parsed as raw HTML, producing zero links; failed Google directory pages could also make baseline links appear removed.
pre_freeze_corrections.resolution: Preserve initial receipt and raw bytes, decode gzip before parsing, reparse cached responses only, and suppress removal claims when directory comparison is incomplete.

findings: Finite ratio1e308 times negative advantage-10 returned an infinite MemOpt loss.
Direct reward inputs around plus/minus1e200 yielded infinite group variance and zero advantages.
pre_freeze_corrections.resolution: Require valid FIRM response rewards in[0,1], zero padding before statistics, and reject nonfinite surrogate/KL/terms/final loss. Dedicated tests and actual diagnostic boolean controls cover both counterexamples.
